evidence: receivers = 1820 and degree_min = degree_max = 495 (regular), consistent with a Kneser graph; binomial_match will confirm (n, k)

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 455 for 1820 receivers. The lower bound 455 is an independent set; the upper bound 455 is a linear code over F_2 with c = 1 (one code tried). All four checks passed: independent_set, code_fits, factorization, decoding. Baselines: CP-SAT alpha reached 455 but was not proven (123 s, over the 120 s limit); CP-SAT cover and fractional cover gave nothing useful (1800 at best); F2 min-rank SAT only reached 454 in 1.2 s. The Kushagra agent also proved 455 over F_2 in 1.9 s, faster than this agent's 31.5 s wall time, of which 30.4 s was LLM time (compute 1.08 s). Nothing suspicious; the agent was slower than the rule-based baseline but equally exact.
